clauses.mechanism: express revocation by EO 12553 (table of revoked orders; effective on signing, February 25, 1986, no effective-date wording)
clauses.reason: Whole order (single operative paragraph, offsets 644-2388 of the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10615.txt, 20 FR 4315): signed 1955-06-17; creates under section 10 of the Railway Labor Act a board of three members to investigate the dispute between certain carriers represented by the Eastern, Western and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committees (list A attached to the order) and certain of their employees represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Firemen and Enginemen; directs the board to report its findings to the President within thirty days from the date of the order; and recites that, as provided by section 10 of that Act, from the date of the order and for thirty days after the board's report no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the parties in the conditions out of which the dispute arose. The attached list or lists identify the carriers and organizations that are parties; they are part of the order but state no separate command. No command in the order has its own fixed end date, sunset or termination clause. The thirty-day report period and the post-report standstill are timing provisions, not ends (owner ruling 2026-10-21, report deadline, option C). No board report for this order is held in the packet (the number-citation scan of held texts finds only the order's own Federal Register page), so the actual report date and the end of the standstill are not recorded; they are spent facts that would not change the end below. First end: Executive Order 12553, Revocation of Various Executive Orders, signed February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, printed March 3, 1986), which orders that the Executive Orders in its table, and any amendments thereto, are revoked. The number 10615 appears in the table at offset 10514 of the held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12553.txt in the column of order numbers (the held OCR prints the numbers and the subjects in separate blocks, so identification rests on the number). EO 12553 contains no effective-date wording, so the revocation is read as effective on signing, February 25, 1986; the filing date (2-26-86) and the printing date are not effective dates. No earlier instrument is shown: the dossier chain for this order contains only EO 12553 and the number-citation scan lists no other later order that revokes, amends, extends or supersedes it.

research_rationale:
EO 10615 is a single-paragraph Railway Labor Act section 10 emergency board order. Its only commands are creation of the board, a thirty-day report deadline and a recited statutory standstill. Under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 (report deadline, option C) none of those ends the order; the first held end is the express revocation by EO 12553 on 1986-02-25 (signature date, no effective-date wording). No board report is held; no spent-fact later event is recorded. Savings: none found in EO 12553 or in the order itself. Searches: U.S. Code and eCFR number-citation searches found no hit for this order; the OFR disposition-note search lists only the EO 12553 revocation in the chain.
